[features]
# When enabled, replaces Phase 1 synthetic measurements with real per-subsystem
# drivers under `src/scenarios/`. Off by default until Phase 2 lands and we have
# 2 weeks of real baseline data.
real_scenarios = []

[package]

input.content:
# Extension trust configuration (Phase 2 schema v1).
#
# Documented in:
# - docs/extension-trust-model.md
# - docs/adr/0003-extension-trust-model.md
#
# Phase 1: this file exists but has no allowlist entries. The runtime stub in
# `packages/profile-core::extension_trust::enforce_extension_trust` returns
# `AllowedBundled` regardless of contents. Phase 2 will read this file and
# classify extensions accordingly.

version: 1

# When false, refuses to load any extension that is not in `extensions` below
# AND signed by an allowlisted publisher. Default false (deny-by-default).
allow_unsigned: false

# Allowlisted publisher pubkeys (base64). Extensions signed by any of these
# publishers and matching the entry below get `AllowedSigned`.
publishers: []

# Per-extension entries. Each entry must include:
#   - id: stable extension id (e.g. `vac.review-tab`)
#   - tier: one of [allowed_bundled, allowed_signed, quarantined, revoked]
#   - source: one of [bundled, signed]
#   - publisher: optional publisher pubkey reference (required when source=signed)
extensions: []
